data.body:
## 1311 IS MERGED — `b301e7513d`. What that does and does NOT establish.

`LLM-Review +1` + `Verified +1`, submitted 22:03. Landed standalone after Gerrit **1314** (my
parallel comment-hygiene fix) was ABANDONED as superseded — another change, `36e986c188`, fixed the
same f124 run-id references first and mine conflicted with it. Rebased onto current main and
re-verified before submit: hygiene gate exits 0, ruff clean, 30 unit cells green.

**ESTABLISHED:** the epic-parent path is implemented and unit-proven. `set_parent` writes a
non-sub-task's parent to the instance-discovered "Epic Link" custom field, with the id looked up BY
NAME and cached per transport; a clear nulls the same field; the decline survives only where the
field genuinely cannot be found, and never falls back to `fields.parent`. Built under held-out TDD —
2 of 6 withheld cells caught real defects the implementer could not see, 6 mutations all killed.

**NOT ESTABLISHED — and AC1 stays unticked until a harness run says otherwise:** whether the write
takes effect against DC 8.17.1. This is exactly where changes 1276, 1288 and 1302 each died with a
green unit suite. A prediction was recorded on this ticket BEFORE the run so a red result is
interpretable on sight rather than rationalised after; the most likely failure remains the Epic Link
not being on the issue's Edit screen, which presents as HTTP 400 naming the customfield and is
SETUP, not a code defect.

**ALSO NOT ESTABLISHED, and newly known:** the round trip does not close. Inbound never reads the
Epic Link ([rebar:9bb9-56a3-e9c0-46e9], now a child of this epic). AC1 as WORDED asks only that the
parent be **emitted** for DC, which this change delivers — but closing 39c1 must not be read as "DC
parent sync works", and I will not word it that way.

**Next:** harness run on the merged sha. Dispatch was deliberately held — `origin/main` was one
commit behind `gerrit/main` at submit time, and a run dispatched then would have silently excluded
this change. Waiting for the mirror rather than trusting the submit's MERGED status.
